hud_card.title: Strafe Speed Histogram
hud_card.text: While you bhop: one bar per air tick, the newest at the bottom and the older ones scrolling up. A bar's length is how fast you turned against the optimal, with a line where the optimal is (the middle, or 3/4 of the width). Bars grow from the left, or from the sides by strafe direction. Its position, width, ticks shown, bar height and colours are set in Momentum Mod's own HUD customizer, where it is listed as Strafe Speed Histogram, and saved with your HUD preset. Turn it off there too.
